notes.title: Update to version 1.0.2
notes.content:
We just updated the game to version 1.0.2.
With this version we fixed some smaller issues (no real bugs) and now a lot of gimmick items in the game appear a bit later to make it a bit easier to come into the main game, without spending too much time in the beginning with pure gimmicks.
